content: Jovenes, Inc., established in 1989, is a non-profit organization based in Los Angeles. Its mission is to provide assistance to homeless and displaced young adults, primarily focusing on areas such as Pico-Union/Westlake, Echo Park, South Central, East Los Angeles, Long Beach, and Hollywood. The organization was founded by Father Richard Estrada, CMF, and initially served as an outreach program for underage immigrants. The name Jovenes translates to youth in Spanish, reflecting the agency's dedication to supporting disenfranchised young individuals through outreach initiatives, social services, and housing programs. In May 2006, Jovenes, Inc. inaugurated its new facility, the Lloyd Monserrat Pleasant House, to further its mission. One of its major programs involves the development of high-quality visual public art projects. These projects are designed to represent the diverse perspectives of life within urban environments.
